memory_candidates.content: In the CSLib intuitionistic propositional tableau (Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/Intuitionistic/), the world-creating F(phi->psi) rule's propagatePersistence (Rules.lean:139-141) duplicates ALL T-formulas at the parent world onto the fresh world, including already-expanded compounds. This means no simple per-step-decreasing raw-complexity Nat measure (the classical-tableau-style Sigma 3^complexity measure) can prove fuel-sufficiency for the INT expansion loop, unlike the classical propositional tableau where classicalExpMeasure works cleanly. Any future fuel-sufficiency proof for intExpandBranches needs a measure over the bounded subformula x world closure, or a measure incorporating remaining world-creation budget as a primary component -- not a direct transplant of the classical per-branch complexity-sum approach.
